scripts.sample-zipwiki: pnpm zipwiki -- pack samples/test2 -o knowledge/sample-docs.zipwiki --no-ai-okf --parser liteparse -sf && pnpm zipaccess -- open knowledge/sample-docs.zipwiki
scripts.smoke:zipaccess: pnpm zipaccess -- open knowledge/sample-docs.zipwiki && pnpm zipaccess -- search knowledge/sample-docs.zipwiki deed
scripts.archive:test1: pnpm zipwiki -- stage samples/test1 --phase all -o samples/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --no-ai-okf --stage-dir samples/.stage/test1 -sf -T && pnpm extract:test1
scripts.archive:test2: pnpm zipwiki -- stage samples/test2 --phase all -o samples/.output/test2/test2.zipwiki --no-ai-okf --stage-dir samples/.stage/test2 -sf -T && pnpm extract:test2
scripts.verify:florida-laws-origins: pnpm --filter @zipwiki/zipwiki exec node --input-type=module -e "import { openPackage } from './dist/lib/access/index.js'; const o=openPackage('../../samples/florida-laws-of-florida.zipwiki'); const n=o.origins.filter(x=>x.originUri).length; console.log(JSON.stringify({primaries:o.primaryCount,originsWithUri:n,sample:o.origins.slice(0,3)},null,2)); if(n!==o.primaryCount){console.error('missing origins'); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.sample-nzip: pnpm run archive:test1 && pnpm run archive:test2
scripts.archive: pnpm run archive:test1 && pnpm run archive:test2
scripts.archive:no-ocr: pnpm zipwiki -- stage samples/test1 --phase all -o samples/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --no-ocr --no-ai-okf --stage-dir samples/.stage/test1 -sf -T && pnpm extract:test1
scripts.archive:timestamp-parsed: pnpm zipwiki -- stage samples/test1 --phase all -o samples/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --parsed-date-from-original --no-ai-okf --stage-dir samples/.stage/test1 -sf -T && pnpm extract:test1
scripts.archive:no-okf: pnpm zipwiki -- stage samples/test1 --phase all -o samples/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --no-okf --stage-dir samples/.stage/test1 -sf -T && pnpm extract:test1
scripts.update:test1:add: pnpm zipwiki -- update samples/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --add samples/test2/property-deed.pdf --no-ai-okf --stage-dir samples/.stage/test1 && pnpm extract:test1 && pnpm list:test1
scripts.update:test1:del: pnpm zipwiki -- update samples/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --del bill-of-rights.pptx --stage-dir samples/.stage/test1 && pnpm extract:test1 && pnpm list:test1
scripts.update:test1:update: pnpm zipwiki -- update samples/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --update samples/test1-update/gettysburg-address.docx --no-ai-okf --stage-dir samples/.stage/test1 && pnpm extract:test1 && pnpm list:test1
scripts.read:test1:multi: pnpm zipwiki -- read -p samples/.output/test1/test1.zipwiki --path wiki/okf/gettysburg-address.md --path wiki/okf/bill-of-rights.md
scripts.read:test2:multi: pnpm zipwiki -- read -p samples/.output/test2/test2.zipwiki --path wiki/okf/property-deed.md --path wiki/okf/introducing-neozip-cli.md
scripts.extract:florida-laws:origin: pnpm zipaccess -- extract samples/florida-laws-of-florida.zipwiki samples/.output/florida-laws --path wiki/parsed/Ch_2025-001.pdf.md --fetch-origin --overwrite
